What Real Performance Looks Like

# Happy Residents. Impressed Clients. Thriving Teams.

Yesterday’s property management software might solve for your efficiency goals, but faster task
execution doesn't equal value. Introducing the AppFolio Performance Platform, built to deliver the
outcomes that everyone needs with unified data, native agentic Al, and new revenue streams.

[Book a Free Demo][7]
by

September 28 - October 1, 2026
San Diego, CA

## The Conference Where Real Estate Performance Takes Shape

Join the industry's most forward-thinking operators, investors, and innovators for four days of bold
ideas, big outcomes, and unforgettable experiences. Hands-on trainings included — a $375 value.

[ Register Now ][8]

## There’s a New Game in Real Estate

[Explore the Platform][9]

### Real Results for Everyone

Market challenges have made operators focus on efficiency. That’s no longer enough. The AppFolio
Performance Platform introduces a new game: real performance for everyone. Our unified experience,
powered by agentic AI, takes on busywork and frees your teams to create exceptional client
experiences, while convenient services generate new top-line revenue and meet resident and investor
needs.

> “Since adopting AppFolio in 2016 with 400 units, we’ve scaled to nearly 14,000 — growth we
> couldn’t have achieved without their technology and partnership.”

Kellie Martin
Chief Operating Officer
Chamberlin & Associates
14,000+ units

### AI Built-In, Not Bolted-On

If you're still doing double data entry, why have AI at all? The AppFolio Performance Platform is
designed from the ground-up with AI as a core building block, not an add-on, making the right
information always available and the best next steps clear. Confidently let the tech do its thing,
and get your people back to doing theirs.

> “It’s very important that AMC runs on an AI-native platform. Because everything is automatically
> integrated into one system, our teams stay focused and productive. Performance insights are
> faster, the user experience is smoother, and it sets us up to scale effectively.”

Danielle Holloway McCarthy
President
Advanced Management Company
12,000+ Units

### All in One Spot

Are you juggling multiple log-ins with your data all over the place? Get a unified experience that
connects property and investment management operations across your portfolio. You can work from
anywhere, on any device, and even integrate your favorite proptech solutions. It's easy for your
teams, convenient for residents, and ideal for investors — so everyone wins.

> “For a long time, we juggled separate, disjointed systems. But now, we’re using one system for
> everything. Having one cohesive interface for both property management and investment management
> makes it really easy to find issues and information, and make sure that all the data is visible to
> the whole team.”

Will Harryman
Development and Operations Manager
Fuller Apartment Homes and Presidio Capital Partners
978+ units, $135M+ EUM

> “With AppFolio, we’re able to do everything from start to finish. We’ve been able to accelerate
> processes in massive ways. Our teams are happier, have more time, and can better serve our
> investors.”

Larry Hickernell Jr.
Senior Director of Investor Success
DLP Capital
9,900+ units

> “Our team has really embraced the ease of AppFolio Realm-X, especially compared to the old manual
> processes we had in place.”

Kellie Martin
Chief Operating Officer
Chamberlin & Associates
14,000+ units

## See Real Performance in Action

Realm-X Flows Realm-X Performers Realm-X Assistant Resident Onboarding
Realm-X Flows

Realm-X Flows is a workflow automation engine that standardizes processes, increases efficiency, and
guides teams to consistently achieve high performance.

[Book a Free Demo][10] [Explore More][11]

## The AppFolio Performance Platform

This new era in real estate requires an entirely new methodology: Real Estate Performance
Management. It’s about proactively shaping your business’s future, not just reacting to challenges.
To achieve this, you need to leave yesterday's property management software behind and embrace a
performance platform designed for real results.

[Learn More][12]

This is Performance

> “We’re able to engage with residents more meaningfully because AppFolio has automated processes
> for us. Our residents know that if they have an issue, they’ll receive a quick response and their
> request will be addressed promptly.”

Tony Julianelle
CEO
Atlas Real Estate
6,500+ units
[Read Their Story][13]

AppFolio Customers Perform More

> “We've built a wonderful partnership with AppFolio, and that partnership means everything to us.
> Their team

### Frequently Asked Questions

Basics Company Pricing Features Compare
What is property management software?

Property management software (like Buildium) helps property managers save time and money by
streamlining their day-to-day operations. Using a range of features, they can keep track of rent
payments, communicate with tenants, schedule maintenance tasks, and generate financial reports.

Property management software may also include tools such as online tenant portals, automated rent
reminders, and mobile apps for access on-the-go, 24/7.

What is Buildium, and who is it for?

Buildium is all-in-one property management software. Its cloud-based platform is purpose-built for
the unique tasks of property managers and real estate professionals.

Some of the key features of Buildium include rental listings, tenant screening, lease management,
rent collection, property accounting, maintenance requests, and communication tools. With Buildium,
users can also access a range of reports and analytics to track their rental income, expenses, and
other key metrics.

What are the typical types of software used in property management?

There’s a lot of software out there—from generic, one-size-fits all to solutions specifically
designed for property management. While there’s really no hard-and-fast rule on which software gets
you the most value (because every situation is different), there are features to look out for that
will make a real impact with the lasting benefits.

To take a deeper look, here are [5 Types of Property Management Software][87] worth investing in.

Why use property management software?

Overall efficiency, ease of communication, accounting you can trust, new revenue streams…if these
are aspects of your business that you’d like to grab ahold of, then there are plenty of reasons why
you’d want to use property management software.

Some of the top benefits involve making [quick work of maintenance][88] with improved response times
and task automation; getting paid faster by [automating payments][89] and collecting rents, fees,
bills and more; keeping in sync with your tenants through an online [resident portal;][90] and
[managing the entire leasing process][91] online including collecting signatures from any device.

What does property management software do?

Property management software helps property managers and landlords streamline their operations and
run their rental properties more efficiently.

For software like Buildium, it gives you a centralized, all-in-one platform for taking on the
day-to-day challenges that are unique to property management with features like property accounting,
online leasing, resident portals, online payments, maintenance management tools, and reporting plus
analytics.

What benefits can I expect from using property management software?

Property management software brings a lot to the table for property management businesses such as
time-saving efficiency by automating day-to-day tasks (rent collection, maintenance requests),
improved organization by centralizing lease and resident data, and streamlining operations
overall—ultimately creating a better property owner, tenant, and homeowner experiences.

What types of properties can be managed using property management software?

No matter what type of property you’re managing, property management software can help. Buildium is
purpose-built for residential property management—including single-family and multi-family rentals
and community associations— and can also handle mixed portfolios with student housing, commercial
properties, storage units, and more.

Is property management software suitable for individual landlords as well as property management
companies?

What is property management software?

Property management software (like Buildium) helps property managers save time and money by
streamlining their day-to-day operations. Using a range of features, they can keep track of rent
payments, communicate with tenants, schedule maintenance tasks, and generate financial reports.

Property management software may also include tools such as online tenant portals, automated rent
reminders, and mobile apps for access on-the-go, 24/7.

What is Buildium, and who is it for?

Buildium is all-in-one property management software. Its cloud-based platform is purpose-built for
the unique tasks of property managers and real estate professionals.

Some of the key features of Buildium include rental listings, tenant screening, lease management,
rent collection, property accounting, maintenance requests, and communication tools. With Buildium,
users can also access a range of reports and analytics to track their rental income, expenses, and
other key metrics.

What are the typical types of software used in property management?

There’s a lot of software out there—from generic, one-size-fits all to solutions specifically
designed for property management. While there’s really no hard-and-fast rule on which software gets
you the most value (because every situation is different), there are features to look out for that
will make a real impact with the lasting benefits.

To take a deeper look, here are [5 Types of Property Management Software][87] worth investing in.

Why use property management software?

Overall efficiency, ease of communication, accounting you can trust, new revenue streams…if these
are aspects of your business that you’d like to grab ahold of, then there are plenty of reasons why
you’d want to use property management software.

Some of the top benefits involve making [quick work of maintenance][88] with improved response times
and task automation; getting paid faster by [automating payments][89] and collecting rents, fees,
bills and more; keeping in sync with your tenants through an online [resident portal;][90] and
[managing the entire leasing process][91] online including collecting signatures from any device.

What does property management software do?

Property management software helps property managers and landlords streamline their operations and
run their rental properties more efficiently.

For software like Buildium, it gives you a centralized, all-in-one platform for taking on the
day-to-day challenges that are unique to property management with features like property accounting,
online leasing, resident portals, online payments, maintenance management tools, and reporting plus
analytics.

What benefits can I expect from using property management software?

Property management software brings a lot to the table for property management businesses such as
time-saving efficiency by automating day-to-day tasks (rent collection, maintenance requests),
improved organization by centralizing lease and resident data, and streamlining operations
overall—ultimately creating a better property owner, tenant, and homeowner experiences.

What types of properties can be managed using property management software?

No matter what type of property you’re managing, property management software can help. Buildium is
purpose-built for residential property management—including single-family and multi-family rentals
and community associations— and can also handle mixed portfolios with student housing, commercial
properties, storage units, and more.

## Automation that fits the way you operate

Every workflow in your business runs at the level of autonomy you choose, from AI-assisted to fully
agentic.
Level 5 Automation
L5 -Adaptive self-improvement
Outcomes from every property feed back so the system tightens the operation over time, not just in a
single task.
Level 4 Automation
L4 -Interactive agents
The system initiates, adapts, and follows through with prospects and residents, with full context
from leases, payments, and maintenance, plus the escalations you define.
Level 3 Automation
L3 -Scalable processing
High volume, messy inputs, and decisions that need expertise are handled at a scale and depth no
operations team can sustain.
Level 2 Automation
L2 -Rules-based orchestration
Structured work runs in sequence: the same inputs, the same steps, the same output, without anyone
touching it.
Level 1 Automation
L1-Generative assistance
The platform answers questions, drafts, and explains using your data and your policies, with an
audit trail behind every response.

## Frequently asked questions about Bidrento

What is Bidrento?

Bidrento is an all-in-one property management platform for **commercial portfolios and/or
residential rentals**. It connects invoicing and utilities, leases, maintenance workflows, tenant
communication, and reporting in one system.

What makes Bidrento different from other property management software?

**1) Automated billing, utilities and cost allocation are built in, not bolted on**
Many property management systems can store rent amounts, but they struggle when billing gets real:
utilities, shared costs, extra services, adjustments, and different rules per building. Bidrento was
built to automate this from the start – so recurring invoices go out automatically, costs are
allocated using clear rules, and changes don’t break your reporting. The result is less manual admin
for finance teams and more accurate, consistent billing across commercial and residential
portfolios. **They call it AI – we call it Bidrento.**

**2) Suitable for both commercial and residential properties**
Most platforms pick a lane (residential-only or commercial-only). Bidrento is designed so teams can
run **commercial leases and/or residential tenancies** side by side, with consistent workflows for
billing, maintenance, and reporting.

**3) Real arrears visibility and payment behaviour tracking**
Instead of “who hasn’t paid”, you can track balances, how long they’ve been overdue, and payment
patterns – so collections becomes a structured process.

**4) Maintenance and planned works in the same system of record**
Requests, work orders, vendors, and unit/building history stay connected – useful for
portfolio-level operations and long-term asset decisions, not just ticket handling.

**5) Tenant portal/app + automation that reduces admin load**
Tenants can handle everyday tasks digitally – access documents, view and pay invoices, and submit
requests – so your team spends less time answering repetitive questions and chasing paperwork.
Bidrento’s built-in AI Assistant can handle common tenant questions and routine requests, freeing up
your team for higher-value work. CO₂ widgets and consumption data give tenants a clear overview of
their usage and impact.

**6) You’re not left alone during rollout**
A lot of PM software sells “self-serve setup.” Bidrento leans into guided onboarding, migration
help, and real support – important when you’re moving active leases, balances, and workflows.

What makes Bidrento Tenant App different from other property management software?

Many property management systems say they have a tenant app, but in practice, it’s often slow,
confusing, or missing the things tenants actually need – so tenants don’t use it, and your team ends
up back in email and phone calls.
Bidrento’s tenant app is different: tenants can **pay invoices**, **access documents**, **submit
maintenance requests**, and **message your team** in one place, and it works reliably day to day.
Bidrento tenant app also supports **add-ons** (extra services like parking, storage, pets, cleaning,
etc.), so tenants can request or purchase services digitally, and the charges can be included in
their billing.
Bidrento’s built-in **AI Assistant** can handle common tenant questions and routine requests,
freeing up your team for higher-value work.
**CO₂ widgets and consumption data** give tenants a clear overview of their usage and impact. For
branded portfolios, **white-label** is available – so tenants see your brand, not a third-party
tool.

## Frequently asked questions about Bidrento

What is Bidrento?

Bidrento is an all-in-one property management platform for **commercial portfolios and/or
residential rentals**. It connects invoicing and utilities, leases, maintenance workflows, tenant
communication, and reporting in one system.

What makes Bidrento different from other property management software?

**1) Automated billing, utilities and cost allocation are built in, not bolted on**
Many property management systems can store rent amounts, but they struggle when billing gets real:
utilities, shared costs, extra services, adjustments, and different rules per building. Bidrento was
built to automate this from the start – so recurring invoices go out automatically, costs are
allocated using clear rules, and changes don’t break your reporting. The result is less manual admin
for finance teams and more accurate, consistent billing across commercial and residential
portfolios. **They call it AI – we call it Bidrento.**

**2) Suitable for both commercial and residential properties**
Most platforms pick a lane (residential-only or commercial-only). Bidrento is designed so teams can
run **commercial leases and/or residential tenancies** side by side, with consistent workflows for
billing, maintenance, and reporting.

**3) Real arrears visibility and payment behaviour tracking**
Instead of “who hasn’t paid”, you can track balances, how long they’ve been overdue, and payment
patterns – so collections becomes a structured process.

**4) Maintenance and planned works in the same system of record**
Requests, work orders, vendors, and unit/building history stay connected – useful for
portfolio-level operations and long-term asset decisions, not just ticket handling.

**5) Tenant portal/app + automation that reduces admin load**
Tenants can handle everyday tasks digitally – access documents, view and pay invoices, and submit
requests – so your team spends less time answering repetitive questions and chasing paperwork.
Bidrento’s built-in AI Assistant can handle common tenant questions and routine requests, freeing up
your team for higher-value work. CO₂ widgets and consumption data give tenants a clear overview of
their usage and impact.

**6) You’re not left alone during rollout**
A lot of PM software sells “self-serve setup.” Bidrento leans into guided onboarding, migration
help, and real support – important when you’re moving active leases, balances, and workflows.

What makes Bidrento Tenant App different from other property management software?

Many property management systems say they have a tenant app, but in practice, it’s often slow,
confusing, or missing the things tenants actually need – so tenants don’t use it, and your team ends
up back in email and phone calls.
Bidrento’s tenant app is different: tenants can **pay invoices**, **access documents**, **submit
maintenance requests**, and **message your team** in one place, and it works reliably day to day.
Bidrento tenant app also supports **add-ons** (extra services like parking, storage, pets, cleaning,
etc.), so tenants can request or purchase services digitally, and the charges can be included in
their billing.
Bidrento’s built-in **AI Assistant** can handle common tenant questions and routine requests,
freeing up your team for higher-value work.
**CO₂ widgets and consumption data** give tenants a clear overview of their usage and impact. For
branded portfolios, **white-label** is available – so tenants see your brand, not a third-party
tool.

Bidrento is built for property managers, asset managers, leasing teams, finance teams, and

The Heroes of Student Housing

Capstone partners with campuses nationwide to anticipate and meet the needs of their student housing
maintenance and operations.

[Get Solutions][31]
[About CMP][32]
About

## Listening Is Step One

Capstone Management Partners is, at its core, a student-minded property management team. We listen
well to understand your unique campus needs and priorities. That’s why we take the time to fully
understand your values before aligning our strategy to fit your organization. You can trust our team
to be approachable, knowledgeable and helpful.

[Who We Are][33]
[Capstone Management Partners Watermark Logo]
Services

## Get a Customized Plan

Our team has the expertise to handle everything from facility maintenance to leasing so that you can
focus on what matters most. Whether you want to delegate all responsibilities or stay involved at
every step, we can tailor our partnership to suit your campus’ needs. We’re all about empowering
students, colleges and universities, providing them with the best tools in student housing.

[Explore Services][34]
Careers

## Meet Our Dedicated Team

If you’re ready to say goodbye to the boring 9 to 5, our team is ready for you! We’re on the lookout
for self-starters, problem-solvers, go-getters — leaders who aren’t afraid to speak up or step up.
If that’s you, you’ll fit right in. Jumpstart your career at Capstone Management Partners!

[Join Us][35]
Portfolio

## Our Work

Capstone provides student housing management, maintenance and operations services to colleges and
universities nationwide. Our diverse portfolio is a reflection of how we fold into the unique
housing programs that span the country.

Cloud Rental Manager is a powerful, all-in-one property management software solution designed
specifically to streamline your rental property operations, maximize efficiency, and boost
profitability. Save time, reduce overhead, and enhance tenant relationships—without paying costly

## Property Management Made Simple

The all-in-one platform built to simplify rental property operations. From online rent collection
and automated lease management to maintenance tracking and real-time financial insights, we help
property managers, landlords, and rental businesses run smarter and scale faster. 

### Streamlined Workflows

Eliminate paperwork and manual tasks with integrated tools that connect leasing, maintenance, and
accounting into one smooth workflow.

### Powerful Automation

Automate repetitive jobs like rent reminders, late fee notices, and status updates, so you save time
and reduce errors.

### Real-Time Insights

Get up-to-the-minute visibility into your portfolio’s performance with live dashboards and reports,
enabling informed decisions on the fly.

We deliver each feature with precision and professionalism, ensuring your operations function
exactly as you need. Here’s how Cloud Rental Manager covers all your property management needs:

Through our partnership with Host Merchant Services, you can get paid quicker by accepting secure,
automated digital payments. Tenants can pay via credit card, debit card, or ACH transfer at some of
the most competitive processing rates in the industry—keeping more of your revenue where it belongs.
No more chasing checks or waiting on the mail—rent flows directly to you on time, every time.

## 2

## Smart Tenant Screening & Digital Application Management

Simplify the entire tenant lifecycle from online applications to background checks and lease
signing, all from one easy-to-use dashboard. Process applications quickly and conduct thorough
screenings to ensure you place the best renters. By centralizing approvals and lease generation, you
fill vacancies faster with less effort.

## 3

## Maintenance Requests Made Simple

Monitor maintenance issues, assign work orders, and fix problems in real time. Tenants can submit
requests through their portal and receive automated updates, keeping them in the loop without your
constant follow-up. Never miss a maintenance issue and resolve problems faster with less effort –
improving tenant satisfaction and protecting your property’s value.

## 4

## Powerful Accounting, Reporting & Insights

Built with property managers in mind, our platform includes full accounting tools and customizable
financial reports. Get instant visibility into cash flow, expenses, payouts, and property
performance with real-time dashboards. Stay on top of your finances effortlessly and make
data-driven decisions to maximize your net operating income.

## 5

## Flexible & Automated Lease Management

Effortlessly create, store, renew, and track your leases from start to finish. Leverage
auto-notifications for upcoming expirations, collect digital signatures, and keep all documents
organized in one place. These features ensure you stay compliant with regulations and eliminate the
chaos of paperwork, making lease management truly stress-free.

## 6

## Integrated Marketing & Vacancy Advertising

Promote your vacant units with built-in marketing tools to attract quality tenants faster. Easily
create listings and share vacancies across popular rental sites or social media to reach a wider
audience. Cloud Rental Manager’s marketing features help you fill vacancies sooner – our users have
significantly grown their portfolios by reaching more renters and filling units quickly.

## 7

## Streamlined Property Inspections & Reports

Schedule and document property inspections with ease using digital checklists and photo uploads.

Manager generates detailed inspection reports, helping you catch issues early and maintain your
properties impeccably.

chaos of paperwork, making lease management truly stress-free.

## Integrated Marketing & Vacancy Advertising

# Student Accommodation Across the UK

[ [sheffield20city20page] ][38]

#### Sheffield

Sheffield offers a student living experience that’s creative, welcoming, and full of contrast. One
minute you’re in a buzzing city centre packed with music venues, cafes, and street art; the next,
you’re hiking in the Peak District. Known for its friendly vibe and strong student community,
Sheffield blends urban energy with outdoor escape. Affordable, down-to-earth, and big on
personality—it’s a city that just gets student life right.

[ Explore city ][39]
[ [Edinburgh] ][40]

#### Edinburgh

Edinburgh is where dramatic landscapes meet buzzing student life. Majestic architecture, winding
streets, and a castle on a hill give the city its storybook charm, but it’s the thriving arts, indie
cafes, and year-round festivals that keep it feeling alive. From cosy pubs in the Old Town to fresh
air hikes up Arthur’s Seat, student life here is as rich as the city’s history. Bold, beautiful, and
endlessly inspiring.

[ Explore city ][41]
[ [london] ][42]

#### London

London is whatever you want it to be. Fast-paced or tucked-away, historic or cutting-edge, it’s all
here, all the time. World-class everything: food, art, nightlife, culture, and countless corners to
make your own. From rooftop bars to hidden bookshops, student life in London is as diverse as the
city itself. Big, bold, and endlessly full of possibility.

[ Explore city ][43]
[ [hatfield] ][44]

#### Hatfield

Hatfield blends convenience with campus life. Just a short ride from London, it offers the best of
both worlds - big city access without the big city rush. The town’s modern touches sit alongside
hints of Tudor history, while green spaces and student-friendly spots keep things chilled. It’s a
no-fuss, well-connected base where everything you need is within easy reach. Simple, smart, and
student-ready.

[ Explore city ][45]
[ [Cardiff] ][46]

#### Cardiff

days to quiet corners in leafy parks and coffee shops, it’s a city of contrasts—in the best way. The
bay brings the water, the castle brings the history, and the high streets and arcades bring
everything in between. Diverse, dynamic, and made for student life.

[ Explore city ][47]
[ [Colchester2] ][48]

and present meet, and students are right at the heart of it.

#### Kingston

a relaxed, leafy vibe, but don’t be fooled, there’s plenty going on. Think bustling markets, buzzing
bars, and a thriving arts scene. With central London just a quick train away and nature on your
doorstep, Kingston hits that sweet spot between calm and connected. Stylish, social, and full of
student energy.

[ Explore city ][51]
[ [falmouth] ][52]

#### Falmouth

Falmouth is where creativity meets the coast. Tucked into Cornwall’s rugged shoreline, this arty
harbour town is all sea breeze, studio spaces, and laid-back vibes. Expect beach bonfires, galleries
tucked down narrow streets, and a community that champions the offbeat. It’s small, sure—but big on
character. For students chasing inspiration (and maybe a surf or two), Falmouth feels like freedom.

[ Explore city ][53]
[ [Newcastle] ][54]

#### Newcastle

Newcastle offers a student living experience that’s vibrant, friendly, and full of character. The
city is famous for its buzzing nightlife, iconic bridges, and rich industrial heritage, all wrapped
up in a compact and walkable centre. With riverside views, lively student areas, and a warm Geordie
welcome, Newcastle strikes the perfect balance between big city excitement and community feel.

[ Explore city ][55]
[ [Plymouth1] ][56]

#### Plymouth

Plymouth offers a student life shaped by the sea and steeped in history. With its dramatic
waterfront, buzzing harbour, and creative quarters, it’s a city that feels both grounded and
adventurous. Expect fresh air, fresh ideas, and a campus right on the coast. From boat trips to
indie gigs, Plymouth’s got a chilled vibe with plenty going on—friendly, open, and always close to
the water.

[ Explore city ][57]
[ [Exeter] ][58]

#### Exeter

Exeter’s got that easy-going rhythm where old meets outdoorsy. Think cathedral spires, cobbled
lanes, and secret gardens—blended with artisan coffee, indie bookshops, and riverside cycling
routes. It’s the kind of place where you can grab brunch in the city and hit the beach by afternoon.
Chill, charming, and quietly full of character—student life flows naturally here.

[ Explore city ][59]
[ [swansea] ][60]

#### Swansea

Swansea brings together beach days and city nights in one laid-back student package. You’ve got
golden sands, coastal paths, and surf spots just minutes from lecture halls—and a nightlife scene
that knows how to keep things lively. It’s friendly, affordable, and full of Welsh charm, with a
creative edge and a community feel. Study by the sea, live at your own pace—Swansea makes it easy.

[ Explore city ][61]
[ [Canterbury] ][62]

#### Canterbury

Canterbury blends old-world charm with a lively student buzz. Cobbled streets, ancient architecture,
and the iconic cathedral set the scene, while indie cafes, riverside pubs, and a thriving arts scene
keep things fresh. It’s a city where history whispers around every corner—but the student energy
keeps it firmly in the now. Cosy, cultural, and effortlessly cool.

[ Explore city ][63]
[ [Oxford1] ][64]

#### Oxford

Oxford is one of those places that feels timeless, but never stuck in time. Think ancient colleges,
hidden gardens, and libraries that smell like history, all mixed with bike rides along the river and
late-night chats in candle-lit pubs. It’s smart, yes—but also quirky, creative, and quietly buzzing
with student life. You don’t just study here - you soak it in.

[ Explore city ][65]
[ [bristol] ][66]

#### Bristol

Bristol offers a student living experience full of creativity and culture, with a thriving music and
arts scene, historic charm, and a strong sense of community. The city is packed with independent
cafes, quirky shops, buzzing nightlife, and green spaces to unwind. With its blend of vibrant city
energy and laid-back atmosphere, Bristol is a dynamic and inspiring place to live and study.

[ Explore city ][67]
[ [penryn] ][68]

#### Penryn

Penryn is small but full of soul. Just up the hill from Falmouth, it’s got cobbled streets, historic
charm, and a tight-knit creative buzz. Students bring the energy, locals bring the warmth, and the
surrounding coastline brings the kind of views that stop you in your tracks. It’s laid-back, a
little offbeat, and the perfect place to focus, make, and just breathe.

[ Explore city ][69]
[ [Aldershot] ][70]

#### Aldershot

Aldershot offers a student living experience rooted in military heritage, with a friendly local vibe
and easy access to nature. The town features a mix of cosy pubs, cafes, and essential high-street
stores, along with great transport links to nearby cities. Surrounded by green spaces and parks,
it’s a relaxed and accessible place to live and study.

[ Explore city ][71]

### Providing you with a place to live, study, and relax - a place to be you

Your student years should be some of the best years of your life, and your student accommodation
plays an important part in this. As the UKs leading and largest independent student accommodation
provider our aim is to enable you to be happy; living in a great location with exceptional
facilities in an environment where you feel safe and well-cared for.

With properties nationwide, we are confident we have the perfect place for you. From the smallest
room through to a palatial studio, large buzzy buildings to boutique properties as well as
accessible rooms; we provide a variety of accommodation to suit you and your budget.

## Why live with CRM Students?

[CRM-Icon-Aubergine-Bed]

#### More than just a room

Student accommodation should be more than just a room, it should be a place you call home. We offer
the opportunity to enhance your university experience, to socialise and meet people from all walks
of life, to learn and grow and the opportunity to enjoy some of the best years of your life!

[CRM-Icon-Aubergine-CCTV]

#### A safe home away from home

With CRM Students you can be assured that while living in the UK you are safe and secure. We make
your safety our priority; with 24-hour CCTV and on-site security teams to make sure your home is
safe, you can live with confidence!

[CRM-Icon-Aubergine-Location]

#### Spaces as unique as you are

We know that every student’s needs are different, and so is every budget. That’s why we offer a wide
range of accommodation options designed to suit all. Whether you're looking for a spacious studio to
call your own, a cosy ensuite room with shared living space, or something in between, you'll find a
place that feels just right.

[
[Falmouth-Penryn2]
][73]

### Make the most of summer! Your student home, sorted


Summer doesn’t have to mean packing up and moving out. Whether you're staying in town for a job,
studying over the break, or just want to enjoy a few more months with friends, our rooms are
available all summer long. No hassle, no stress! Just the same great space, ready when you need it.

Our summer stays are flexible, fully furnished, and all-inclusive, so you can focus on what matters
most, from catching up on uni work to making the most of longer days and warmer weather. You’ll have
everything you need: fast Wi-Fi, on-site support, and inviting social spaces to relax or connect
with others.

Already living with us? You can extend your stay with ease. New to the area? Our welcoming team will
help you settle in quickly. However you plan to spend your summer, we’ll make sure you’ve got a
comfortable, secure place to call home.

[ Explore city ][53]
[ [Newcastle] ][54]

#### Newcastle

Newcastle offers a student living experience that’s vibrant, friendly, and full of character. The
city is famous for its buzzing nightlife, iconic bridges, and rich industrial heritage, all wrapped
up in a compact and walkable centre. With riverside views, lively student areas, and a warm Geordie
welcome, Newcastle strikes the perfect balance between big city excitement and community feel.

[ Explore city ][55]
[ [Plymouth1] ][56]

#### Plymouth

Plymouth offers a student life shaped by the sea and steeped in history. With its dramatic
waterfront, buzzing harbour, and creative quarters, it’s a city that feels both grounded and
adventurous. Expect fresh air, fresh ideas, and a campus right on the coast. From boat trips to
indie gigs, Plymouth’s got a chilled vibe with plenty going on—friendly, open, and always close to
the water.

[ Explore city ][57]
[ [Exeter] ][58]

#### Exeter

Exeter’s got that easy-going rhythm where old meets outdoorsy. Think cathedral spires, cobbled
lanes, and secret gardens—blended with artisan coffee, indie bookshops, and riverside cycling
routes. It’s the kind of place where you can grab brunch in the city and hit the beach by afternoon.
Chill, charming, and quietly full of character—student life flows naturally here.

[ Explore city ][59]
[ [swansea] ][60]

#### Swansea

Swansea brings together beach days and city nights in one laid-back student package. You’ve got
golden sands, coastal paths, and surf spots just minutes from lecture halls—and a nightlife scene
that knows how to keep things lively. It’s friendly, affordable, and full of Welsh charm, with a
creative edge and a community feel. Study by the sea, live at your own pace—Swansea makes it easy.

[ Explore city ][61]
[ [Canterbury] ][62]

#### Canterbury

Canterbury blends old-world charm with a lively student buzz. Cobbled streets, ancient architecture,
and the iconic cathedral set the scene, while indie cafes, riverside pubs, and a thriving arts scene
keep things fresh. It’s a city where history whispers around every corner—but the student energy
keeps it firmly in the now. Cosy, cultural, and effortlessly cool.

[ Explore city ][63]
[ [Oxford1] ][64]

#### Oxford

Oxford is one of those places that feels timeless, but never stuck in time. Think ancient colleges,
hidden gardens, and libraries that smell like history, all mixed with bike rides along the river and
late-night chats in candle-lit pubs. It’s smart, yes—but also quirky, creative, and quietly buzzing
with student life. You don’t just study here - you soak it in.

[ Explore city ][65]
[ [bristol] ][66]

#### Bristol

Bristol offers a student living experience full of creativity and culture, with a thriving music and
arts scene, historic charm, and a strong sense of community. The city is packed with independent
cafes, quirky shops, buzzing nightlife, and green spaces to unwind. With its blend of vibrant city
energy and laid-back atmosphere, Bristol is a dynamic and inspiring place to live and study.

[ Explore city ][67]
[ [penryn] ][68]

#### Penryn

Penryn is small but full of soul. Just up the hill from Falmouth, it’s got cobbled streets, historic
charm, and a tight-knit creative buzz. Students bring the energy, locals bring the warmth, and the
surrounding coastline brings the kind of views that stop you in your tracks. It’s laid-back, a
little offbeat, and the perfect place to focus, make, and just breathe.

[ Explore city ][69]
[ [Aldershot] ][70]

#### Aldershot

Aldershot offers a student living experience rooted in military heritage, with a friendly local vibe
and easy access to nature. The town features a mix of cosy pubs, cafes, and essential high-street
stores, along with great transport links to nearby cities. Surrounded by green spaces and parks,
it’s a relaxed and accessible place to live and study.

### What is a property management software?

Rental property management software is an all-in-one system that helps landlords, property managers,
and real estate investors run rentals online, handling [tenant screening][92], e-leases, rent
collection, [maintenance][93], and accounting in one place. It replaces spreadsheets and multiple
tools so you save time, reduce errors, and scale more easily

### How much does property management software cost?

Most platforms charge $1–$10+ per unit/month or offer a flat fee, with higher tiers adding features
like accounting, maintenance, and [integrations][94].

DoorLoop starts at $69/month with plans that scale by unit count and feature needs, so you only pay
for what you use.

[See Pricing and compare plans.][95]

‍

### Is there free property management software available?

Yes. some platforms offer free plans, but they often limit units and exclude essentials like full
accounting, online payments, maintenance, reporting, or portals. Some include ads, fees, or minimal
support.

**DoorLoop isn’t free**, but it’s intentionally affordable and designed to **save more than it
costs** by reducing manual work, consolidating tools, and improving collections.

Want to see the ROI? [Schedule a free demo][96]

‍

### What is DoorLoop, and who is it for?

DoorLoop is a cloud-based property management software built for landlords, property managers, and
investors of any size.

Manage everything end-to-end: online rent payments, screening, lease management, maintenance
requests, full accounting, reporting, portals, and integrations (including [Quickbooks][97]).

Trusted by thousands of real estate professionals [[See our G2 Reviews][98]] worldwide, DoorLoop
helps you streamline operations and grow your portfolio with less busywork.

Learn how smart property managers are reclaiming 5+ hours every week and growing their portfolios
with DoorLoop - [Download the full research here. ][99]

### How many programs will DoorLoop replace?

A single login replaces multiple subscriptions and manual workflows. With DoorLoop, you can:

* Create rental applications and e-leases (no more Word docs)

* Automate background checks (no manual screening)
* Collect rent online and reduce admin work
* Track maintenance requests, vendors, and SLAs
* Set automated reminders for tasks and renewals

Explore [features][101] or [schedule a free demo][102]

collection, [maintenance][93], and accounting in one place. It replaces spreadsheets and multiple
tools so you save time, reduce errors, and scale more easily

### How much does property management software cost?

Most platforms charge $1–$10+ per unit/month or offer a flat fee, with higher tiers adding features
like accounting, maintenance, and [integrations][94].

DoorLoop starts at $69/month with plans that scale by unit count and feature needs, so you only pay

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads

  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.

  Endpoints + docs added

  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

01
[F logo]
Fathom.ai
Fathom.ai is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls on Zoom,
Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company was founded in 2020 by Richard White, a computer
science engineer who previously co-built UserVoice over roughly 12 years, scaling it to $10 million
in revenue before transitioning out in 2019. Fathom has grown from $100K ARR in 2022 to $1M in 2023,
$10M in 2024, and $30M in 2025, a trajectory White describes as "zero to one, one to 10, and 10 to
30 in the first three years of monetization." The company has raised $30 million total across three
rounds, including a $10M seed in 2021, a $3M seed in 2023, and a $17M Series A in 2024 at a $73M
valuation. The team has grown to 100 people. Average revenue per customer is approximately $25 per
seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.
That bet proved correct, and the free individual tier became the distribution engine for a paid team
product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

May 2023 by David Zitoun and his co-founder, and is headquartered in France with most of its revenue
coming from the United States. Zitoun serves as Co-Founder and CEO and runs the company with a team
of 13 people. SubMagic reached $1M ARR exactly three months after acquiring its first customer in
May 2023, hitting that milestone on August 1, 2023. By June 2025, the company had grown to $8M ARR,
fully bootstrapped with no outside funding. The company sees between 5,000 and 10,000 new signups
per day, converted roughly 2,500 new paid customers in its most recent month, and carries a monthly
logo churn rate of approximately 15%. Its affiliate program, which pays 30% of lifetime customer
value, accounts for more than 10,000 active affiliates and directly drives 20% of total revenue. The
single most striking strategic fact is that SubMagic scaled from zero to $8M ARR in two years with
13 employees, generating roughly $700,000 of revenue per employee, by combining precise timing with
the short-form content boom, a generous affiliate program launched within 30 days of its first
customer, and a relentless focus on a three-click product experience rather than paid acquisition.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What is Netflix?
  
  Netflix is a streaming service that offers a wide variety of award-winning TV shows, movies,
  anime, documentaries and more – on thousands of internet-connected devices.
  
  You can watch as much as you want, whenever you want, without a single ad – all for one low
  monthly price. There's always something new to discover, and new TV shows and movies are added
  every week!
* ### How much does Netflix cost?
  
  New members can try 30 days of Netflix for ₹0. After the free trial ends, your plan will
  automatically renew at the regular price depending on the plan you select. Plans range from ₹149
  to ₹649.
  
  Watch Netflix on your smartphone, tablet, Smart TV, laptop or streaming device. No extra costs,
  cancel at anytime.
* ### Where can I watch?
  
  Watch anywhere, anytime. Sign in with your Netflix account to watch instantly on the web at
  netflix.com from your personal computer or on any internet-connected device that offers the
  Netflix app, including smart TVs, smartphones, tablets, streaming media players and game consoles.
  
  You can also download your favourite shows with the iOS or Android app. Use downloads to watch
  while you're on the go and without an internet connection. Take Netflix with you anywhere.
* ### How do I cancel?
  
  Netflix is flexible. You can easily cancel your account online in two clicks. There are no
  cancellation fees – start or stop your account anytime.
* ### What can I watch on Netflix?
  
  Netflix has an extensive library of feature films, documentaries, shows, anime, award-winning
  Netflix originals, and more. Watch as much as you want, anytime you want.
* ### Is Netflix good for kids?
  
  The Netflix Kids experience is included in your membership to give parents control while kids
  enjoy family-friendly TV shows and films in their own space.
  
  Kids profiles come with PIN-protected parental controls that let you restrict the maturity rating
  of content kids can watch and block specific titles you don’t want kids to see.

**Imagine a vast collection of business apps at your disposal.**
Got something to improve? There is an app for that.
No complexity, no cost, just a one-click install.

Each app simplifies a process and empowers more people.
Imagine the impact when everyone gets the right tool for the job, tailored with native AI.

If you simplify everything, you can do anything!
- Bill McDermott, former CEO of SAP

## Level up your quality of work

## Optimized for productivity

**Experience true speed,** reduced data entry, smart AI, and a fast UI. All operations are done in
less than 90ms - faster than a blink.

[ Compare with SAP][178]

## Native AI across all your business

Automate work, tailor features, perform deep research, and **scale without limits.**

## Enterprise software
## done right.

#### Open source

Behind the technology is a community of 100k+ developers collaborating worldwide. We're united by
the spirit of open source, and a common vision: "to transform companies, empower employees".

Odoo is available in two editions:
• **Community**: Open Source, 100% free.
• **Enterprise**: extra apps, infrastructure and professional services.

[Compare Editions][179]

#### Open Source + AI = ❤️

Use [Odoo.sh][180] to develop or vibe-code tailored modules. As we are open source, LLMs are already
trained on our source code.

[Odoo Sh AI]

#### 40k+ community apps

Thanks to its open source development model, Odoo became the world's largest business apps store.
Imagine getting an app for every business needs.

[Browse Community Apps][181]

#### No corporate bullsh*t

"With most systems, you get 70% of what you hoped. With Odoo, you get more than what you expected.
You, guys, will transform the market." - Anonymous competitor

#### No vendor lock-in

No proprietary data format, just PostgreSQL: you own your data. No software lock-in: you get the
source code, GitHub access, and the flexibility to host on our infrastructure, or on premise.

[Follow us on GitHub][182]

#### Fair pricing

No usage-based pricing, no feature upselling, no long term contracts, no hosting limits, no
surprises... just a single price per user - all inclusive.

[View Pricing][183]

#### A unique value proposition

[Unique value]

###### Join 28 million happy users

who grow their business with Odoo

> The processing time for accounting documents has been noticeably reduced, in certain cases even
> from 2 days to only 5 hours. As a result we can now focus on what matters: reporting and advising
> the client.

[Harry Van Donink picture]
**Harry Van Donink**
CEO KPMG Belgium

### your growth potential

**Imagine a vast collection of business apps at your disposal.**
Got something to improve? There is an app for that.
No complexity, no cost, just a one-click install.

Each app simplifies a process and empowers more people.
Imagine the impact when everyone gets the right tool for the job, tailored with native AI.

If you simplify everything, you can do anything!
- Bill McDermott, former CEO of SAP

## Level up your quality of work

## Optimized for productivity

**Experience true speed,** reduced data entry, smart AI, and a fast UI. All operations are done in
less than 90ms - faster than a blink.

[ Compare with SAP][178]

## Native AI across all your business

Automate work, tailor features, perform deep research, and **scale without limits.**

## Enterprise software
## done right.

#### Open source

Behind the technology is a community of 100k+ developers collaborating worldwide. We're united by
the spirit of open source, and a common vision: "to transform companies, empower employees".

Odoo is available in two editions:
• **Community**: Open Source, 100% free.
• **Enterprise**: extra apps, infrastructure and professional services.

[Compare Editions][179]

#### Open Source + AI = ❤️

Use [Odoo.sh][180] to develop or vibe-code tailored modules. As we are open source, LLMs are already
trained on our source code.

[Odoo Sh AI]

#### 40k+ community apps

Thanks to its open source development model, Odoo became the world's largest business apps store.
Imagine getting an app for every business needs.

[Browse Community Apps][181]

#### No corporate bullsh*t

"With most systems, you get 70% of what you hoped. With Odoo, you get more than what you expected.
You, guys, will transform the market." - Anonymous competitor

#### No vendor lock-in

No proprietary data format, just PostgreSQL: you own your data. No software lock-in: you get the
source code, GitHub access, and the flexibility to host on our infrastructure, or on premise.

[Follow us on GitHub][182]

#### Fair pricing

No usage-based pricing, no feature upselling, no long term contracts, no hosting limits, no
surprises... just a single price per user - all inclusive.

[View Pricing][183]

#### A unique value proposition

who grow their business with Odoo

> the client.

## Always **here to help**

Our support team knows the rental journey inside and out –  and we’re here 24/7 to lend a helping
hand.

## Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about RentRedi’s property management software.

How do I get started with RentRedi?

Setup takes minutes. RentRedi’s AI-powered onboarding guides you through adding properties,
connecting your bank, and inviting tenants—so you can start collecting rent faster. Live chat and
free onboarding support make getting started easy.

How does smart rent collection work?

Tenants can pay rent through the RentRedi app via ACH, card, or cash at 90,000+ retail locations.
You’ll get instant payment notifications, deposit tracking, and automatic receipts—all from your
dashboard.

Does RentRedi include tenant screening?

Yes—RentRedi partners with TransUnion for credit, criminal, and eviction checks. Applicants pay
directly, and you get verified reports instantly to help choose reliable tenants and reduce
turnover.

How does maintenance management work?

Tenants submit photo or video requests in the app, and you can coordinate repairs through RentRedi’s
partner network. Every request is tracked and updated automatically—keeping landlords and tenants
informed.

What does RentRedi cost?

RentRedi offers simple, flat-rate pricing with no hidden fees. Every plan includes unlimited units,
tenants, and team members—so you can scale your portfolio without extra costs.

Our support team knows the rental journey inside and out –  and we’re here 24/7 to lend a helping
hand.

## Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about RentRedi’s property management software.

How do I get started with RentRedi?

Setup takes minutes. RentRedi’s AI-powered onboarding guides you through adding properties,
connecting your bank, and inviting tenants—so you can start collecting rent faster. Live chat and
free onboarding support make getting started easy.

How does smart rent collection work?

Tenants can pay rent through the RentRedi app via ACH, card, or cash at 90,000+ retail locations.
You’ll get instant payment notifications, deposit tracking, and automatic receipts—all from your
dashboard.

Does RentRedi include tenant screening?

Yes—RentRedi partners with TransUnion for credit, criminal, and eviction checks. Applicants pay
directly, and you get verified reports instantly to help choose reliable tenants and reduce
turnover.

How does maintenance management work?

Tenants submit photo or video requests in the app, and you can coordinate repairs through RentRedi’s
partner network. Every request is tracked and updated automatically—keeping landlords and tenants
informed.

What does RentRedi cost?

RentRedi offers simple, flat-rate pricing with no hidden fees. Every plan includes unlimited units,
tenants, and team members—so you can scale your portfolio without extra costs.

### Automated late fee assessment

Set your rules once—first-day fees, daily fees, minimum balances—and the system applies them
automatically. No manual calculations, no missed assessments, no exceptions unless you make them.

### Flexible payment plans

Offer installment options that increase conversions while protecting your cash flow. Residents can
choose plans that work for them, and you maintain predictable revenue. The system tracks everything.

### Daily automated billing

Every day, Room Choice checks scheduled payments and charges residents automatically. Failed
payment? The system retries and notifies your team. You wake up to collected revenue, not work to
do.

### Real-time balance tracking

Know exactly who owes what, when they owe it, and what's been collected—instantly. Ledger entries,
payment history, and outstanding balances all in one place. No reconciliation headaches.

### E-signature automation

Upload your lease template once. Send contracts for signature with one click. Track status in
real-time. Signed documents stored automatically. No printing, no scanning, no chasing down
paperwork. Dropbox Sign integration handles multi-party signatures (students, guarantors,
co-signers) seamlessly.

### Self-service resident portal

Residents check balances, make payments, set up auto-pay, submit maintenance requests, and access
lease documents—24/7, without calling your office. The result? Fewer routine calls to your office,
happier residents who can help themselves, and staff who can focus on higher-value work.

### Automated maintenance ticketing

Every maintenance request becomes a tracked ticket. Assign to staff, set priorities, add notes,
attach photos, track resolution—all in one system. No more requests lost in email or voicemail.
Recurring maintenance schedules automatically.

### Template-based communications

Create message templates for common questions and scenarios. Answer repetitive inquiries in seconds
instead of minutes. Send personalized messages at scale. Email and SMS integration means you can
reach residents however they prefer, all from one platform.

Occupancy Management

## Fill Beds Faster, Stay Full Longer

Every Empty Bed Is Lost Revenue

Converting inquiries to applications to signed leases—while managing waitlists, tracking
availability, and keeping current residents happy—requires systems, not spreadsheets.

The challenge:

You need visibility into your entire pipeline, from first contact through move-in. You need to
convert applications quickly, manage demand strategically, and never lose track of a prospect.

Full pipeline visibility
See every prospect from inquiry through move-in
Integrated screening
TransUnion credit and background checks built in
Automated waitlists
Demand converts to assignments when beds open
Real-time availability
Know what's open, pending, and coming available
See the Leasing Pipeline

### Integrated application and screening

Prospects apply online with your custom application form. Credit checks, background reports, and
eviction history pull automatically via TransUnion integration. The system generates screening
recommendations (Accept, Decline, Conditional, Refer) based on your criteria. Review, approve, and
move to lease—all in one workflow.

### Waitlist management

Track demand even when you're full. Waitlist entries automatically convert to assignments when beds
become available. You'll never miss an opportunity to fill a vacancy. Priority management ensures
you're assigning beds to the right applicants at the right time.

### Real-time assignment tracking

See bed/room/unit availability across all properties instantly. Know exactly what's available,
what's assigned, what's pending, and what's coming available soon. Move-in and move-out date
tracking gives you forward visibility. Plan turnovers, coordinate maintenance, and optimize
occupancy systematically.

### Rent roll reporting

Generate rent rolls instantly: current occupancy, tenant details, lease dates, rent amounts, payment
status—all in one report. Perfect for lenders, investors, or your own planning.

### Multi-property dashboard

See occupancy rates, revenue, outstanding balances, and operational status across your entire
portfolio from one screen. Drill down to individual properties, buildings, or even specific beds
with one click. No more logging into different systems or reconciling data from multiple sources.

### Per-property customization

Different late fee rules for different markets? Done. Custom payment schedules by property? Easy.
Property-specific branding, terminology, and processes? All supported. Room Choice gives you the
control to run each property the way it needs to run, while maintaining centralized oversight.

### Centralized reporting

Settlement reports, rent rolls, payment analytics, occupancy tracking—all available at the portfolio
level or per property. Compare performance across locations, identify trends, make data-driven
decisions. Export reports for lenders, investors, or your own planning.

### Automated settlements

Funds collected at each property transfer to the appropriate property bank accounts automatically.
Fees are separated and tracked cleanly. You maintain separate financials per property while managing
everything from one platform.

Multi-Property Scaling

## Scale to Multiple Properties With Complete Confidence

One Dashboard. Multiple Properties. Complete Control.

Growing from one property to three shouldn't mean three times the software costs, three separate
logins, and zero visibility across your portfolio.

What you actually need:

Centralized visibility and control with the flexibility to customize per property. One login, one
dashboard, complete portfolio oversight—without losing the ability to adapt to each property's
unique needs.

Single login
Access every property from one dashboard
Portfolio-level reporting
Compare performance across locations instantly
Per-property rules
Different rates, fees, and processes per location
Automated settlements
Funds route to the right accounts automatically

E-signatures replace printing, scanning, and chasing paperwork
Everything tracked
Maintenance requests, communications, and tasks in one system
See How It Works
Occupancy Management

## Fill Beds Faster, Stay Full Longer

Every Empty Bed Is Lost Revenue

Converting inquiries to applications to signed leases—while managing waitlists, tracking
availability, and keeping current residents happy—requires systems, not spreadsheets.

The challenge:

You need visibility into your entire pipeline, from first contact through move-in. You need to
convert applications quickly, manage demand strategically, and never lose track of a prospect.

Full pipeline visibility
See every prospect from inquiry through move-in
Integrated screening
TransUnion credit and background checks built in
Automated waitlists
Demand converts to assignments when beds open
Real-time availability
Know what's open, pending, and coming available
See the Leasing Pipeline

### Integrated application and screening

Prospects apply online with your custom application form. Credit checks, background reports, and
eviction history pull automatically via TransUnion integration. The system generates screening
recommendations (Accept, Decline, Conditional, Refer) based on your criteria. Review, approve, and
move to lease—all in one workflow.

### Waitlist management

Track demand even when you're full. Waitlist entries automatically convert to assignments when beds
become available. You'll never miss an opportunity to fill a vacancy. Priority management ensures
you're assigning beds to the right applicants at the right time.

### Real-time assignment tracking

See bed/room/unit availability across all properties instantly. Know exactly what's available,
what's assigned, what's pending, and what's coming available soon. Move-in and move-out date
tracking gives you forward visibility. Plan turnovers, coordinate maintenance, and optimize
occupancy systematically.

### Rent roll reporting

Generate rent rolls instantly: current occupancy, tenant details, lease dates, rent amounts, payment
status—all in one report. Perfect for lenders, investors, or your own planning.

### Multi-property dashboard

See occupancy rates, revenue, outstanding balances, and operational status across your entire
portfolio from one screen. Drill down to individual properties, buildings, or even specific beds
with one click. No more logging into different systems or reconciling data from multiple sources.

### Per-property customization

Different late fee rules for different markets? Done. Custom payment schedules by property? Easy.
Property-specific branding, terminology, and processes? All supported. Room Choice gives you the
control to run each property the way it needs to run, while maintaining centralized oversight.

### Centralized reporting

Settlement reports, rent rolls, payment analytics, occupancy tracking—all available at the portfolio
level or per property. Compare performance across locations, identify trends, make data-driven
decisions. Export reports for lenders, investors, or your own planning.

### Automated settlements

Funds collected at each property transfer to the appropriate property bank accounts automatically.
Fees are separated and tracked cleanly. You maintain separate financials per property while managing
everything from one platform.

Multi-Property Scaling

## Scale to Multiple Properties With Complete Confidence

One Dashboard. Multiple Properties. Complete Control.

Growing from one property to three shouldn't mean three times the software costs, three separate
logins, and zero visibility across your portfolio.

What you actually need:

Centralized visibility and control with the flexibility to customize per property. One login, one
dashboard, complete portfolio oversight—without losing the ability to adapt to each property's
unique needs.

Single login
Access every property from one dashboard
Portfolio-level reporting
Compare performance across locations instantly
Per-property rules
Different rates, fees, and processes per location
Automated settlements
Funds route to the right accounts automatically
See Multi-Property Management

Reduce costs, grow revenue, and run your property more efficiently on a platform built for 200+ bed
complexities.

Reduce conflicts by 85% with intelligent roommate pairing based on lifestyle preferences, schedules,
and compatibility scores.

FAQS

### Questions? We have answers.

Is Showdigs compatible with other property listing software?

Yes! If you currently use Appfolio or Yardi for your listings, don't worry. Showdigs is compatible
with all major listing software for property managers. Once you sign up for a Showdigs account, our
Customer Success team will guide you through your custom onboarding process, including setting up
your listing syndication.

**What are my options when it comes to tours and showings?**

You have ultimate flexibility when it comes to how you want to show your properties. Showdigs can
schedule and assign showing to your own staff or we can have a Showdigs Agent do it on your behalf!
You have complete control, allowing you to do what works best for your business. You can have all
showings go to your in-house staff, all go to Showdigs Agents, and everything in between! We can
even be a backup agent for when your staff is all booked up.

In addition to in-person tours with agents, we also offer an automated self-showing option with
built-in identity screening of prospects.

What cities do you have Showdigs Agents available?

[Click here to view where our Agent Network is active!][66] Our scheduling platform and
self-showings are available nationwide.

Is it possible to order one-off services without activating a property?

Service Add-ons, such as on-demand condition reports and marketing photos, are available to order
and purchase without paying to activate a listing.

What is a condition report and how does it work?

A condition report is designed to document the current condition of a property via photos and
written descriptions. Mid-Tenancy condition reports are used when you want to check the condition of
an occupied property, which we recommend doing every 6-9 months. Move-In/Move-Out condition reports
are for vacant properties that are being turned over - these are frequently used to document the
condition of a property to protect against security deposit disputes. Once ordered, Showdigs handles
all scheduling and tenant communication. Then we send a licensed, trained agent to conduct a

### Questions? We have answers.

Is Showdigs compatible with other property listing software?

Yes! If you currently use Appfolio or Yardi for your listings, don't worry. Showdigs is compatible
with all major listing software for property managers. Once you sign up for a Showdigs account, our
Customer Success team will guide you through your custom onboarding process, including setting up

**What are my options when it comes to tours and showings?**

You have ultimate flexibility when it comes to how you want to show your properties. Showdigs can
schedule and assign showing to your own staff or we can have a Showdigs Agent do it on your behalf!
You have complete control, allowing you to do what works best for your business. You can have all

even be a backup agent for when your staff is all booked up.

Service Add-ons, such as on-demand condition reports and marketing photos, are available to order

written descriptions. Mid-Tenancy condition reports are used when you want to check the condition of
an occupied property, which we recommend doing every 6-9 months. Move-In/Move-Out condition reports

## Postgraduate study at Scotland's top university

St Andrews is Scottish University of the Year and second in the UK in both [The Times and Sunday
Times Good University Guide 2026][17] and [The Guardian University Guide 2026][18].

Join our postgraduate community and access world-leading research facilities and cutting-edge
resources. Our taught Masters degrees and flexible online courses allow you to achieve your
potential and advance your career.

## Postgraduate study at Scotland's top university

St Andrews is Scottish University of the Year and second in the UK in both [The Times and Sunday
Times Good University Guide 2026][17] and [The Guardian University Guide 2026][18].

Join our postgraduate community and access world-leading research facilities and cutting-edge
resources. Our taught Masters degrees and flexible online courses allow you to achieve your
potential and advance your career.

[Explore Masters study ][19] [Online Masters][20]

Master your ambition. Where academic heritage meets global impact. Where your future starts.

Video transcript

[Music]

>> **Professor Kishan Dholakia, School of Physics and Astronomy:** By having a very strong research
active University that competes with the best internationally, we can teach our postgraduate
community how to evolve as researchers, how to work with our peer groups, in a way that wouldn't
happen were we have to focus solely on teaching.

>> **Ethan, PhD Philosophy: **The research interests of the academic staff was the most important
thing when deciding to come here.

>> **Webster, PhD Divinity:** I find being in this place academically challenging, stimulating, and
the community is captivating.

>> **Julia, MLitt Museum and Gallery Studies: **As a student, St Andrews is a world of it’s own. I
just think it is the most brilliant and other-worldly place you could ever have.

>> **Webster, PhD Divinity:** To be a student in St Andrews is the ultimate of student experience in
higher education.

>> **Professor Judith Wolfe, School of Divinity:** St Andrews is a very special University because
it is so small and intimate, and yet punches so far above its weight, in terms of research, in terms
of the caliber of students that we get, and in terms of community.

>> **Fiona, PhD Medicine:** The postgraduate community in St Andrews is quite a close-knit one.

>> **Hoi Chun, MLitt Marketing:** Very warm and welcoming. Really easy to get to know them just
because you are in a small town. You get that sense of belonging.

>> **Dr Dharani Balasubramaniam, School of Computer Science:** St Andrews is a research intensive
University. Most of the teaching staff are research active. So their interests feed into teaching.

>> The research really is the life blood of the University.

>> **Nicole, MLitt Terrorism and Political Violence: **The professors are always putting out new
pieces of research. They really are pioneers in the field.

>> **Julie Brooks, School of Management: **We’re very lucky at St Andrews. We have really the best
of the best applying, and it means we really get a very, very high quality student.

>> **Dr James Rae, School of Earth and Environmental Sciences:** We want people who are curious, who
are motivated, who want to understand the world around them.

>> **Dr Charles Warren, School of Geography and Sustainable Development:** People who are willing to
be challenged, and also to challenge, and people beyond their studies, people who are keen to
contribute to the wider life of the University.

>> **Gabrielle, MSc Marine Mammal Science:** I’ve learned a lot of things and I’ve made so many
contacts. It’s been the best experience of my entire life. I've loved every second of it.

>> One of the things that is really important is that we are a community of scholars. The staff and
the students.

>> **Hannah, MLitt Museum and Gallery Studies:** Life at St Andrews is wonderful. I think it’s
completely unique. There’s so much to do, you cannot be bored.

>> **Morag, PhD Modern History:** I have so many ideas about what I’m going to do when I graduate.
I’ve had loads of opportunities and I’ve met so many new people.

>> St Andrews has an excellent track record of seeing their postgraduates move on to illustrious
careers in all walks of life.

>> Students make a lot of contacts during their studies, and that can lead to career opportunities
once they graduate.

>> **Professor Frank Lorenz Muller, Dean of Arts and Divinity:** We have everything from lawyers, to
diplomats, to journalists. They come with this great mark of quality on to a market that wants to
take them into either professional or academic life afterwards.

>> When I was studying biology I read a book written by one of the professors here. Getting to have
classes and meet him was, like, amazing for me!

>> **Kara, MLitt Terrorism and Political Violence:** It was really a non-brainer when I went

## Making Waves: The Campaign for St Andrews

Great universities never stand still. They must take the lead as society’s engines of innovation and
change, and St Andrews needs to be at the forefront.

Making Waves: The Campaign for St Andrews aims to raise £300 million to achieve this ambition
through a number of the key projects. 

With your support, we can make waves and shape the future not only of our University, but of our
world.

[More about the campaign][37]

[waves pattern on sea]

[All news][38]
[New College site model]

### [Green light for New College][39]

Major plans to redevelop one of the most significant sites in the town have been given the green
light.

[Students graduating in 2026]

### [A week to remember][40]

It was a week to remember from Monday 29 June to Friday 3 July 2026 when the University celebrated
the Class of 2026.

[Principal and Vice-Chancellor Dame Sally Mapstone and Chancellor Dame Anne Pringle]

### [New Chancellor installed][41]

Dame Anne Pringle was formally installed as Chancellor during a graduation ceremony in July 2026.

## Events at St Andrews

The University of St Andrews hosts a vibrant mix of events, from academic lectures and research
conferences to concerts, exhibitions and cultural festivals.

Whether engaging in discussions, celebrating traditions or enjoying live performances, there’s
always something to experience.

[All upcoming events][42]

## Race Equality Charter award for St Andrews

The University has achieved an AdvanceHE Race Equality Charter (REC) Bronze Award in recognition of
its work to improve the representation, progression and success of Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic
people at St Andrews.

inception to completion.

Brian Clapp, One Street Residential

budget reassuring.

and their follow-up makes me know that they have all of our projects under control and never worry
about delays. I highly recommend them!”

Sarah Weeks, Piedmont Healthcare

punch-list, we understand the importance of on-time installation.

for the best look and efficient in getting it installed on our timeline.”

Sarah Freeman, UGA Grady College of Journalism

Our in-house fabrication & production teams bring our designs to life. From ADA signage to UL-listed
electric signs, we make it all here in our facility.

“Working with The Sign Brothers team has been a great experience from site survey to in-field
installation.  From start to finish, The Sign Brothers provides a professional response from a
growing team of qualified team members.  I look forward to our future endeavors.”

Adam Stroup, BDR Partners

## Key Billing Software Features Built for
## Indian SME Owners

[Multiple Payment Options][Multiple Payment Options]

### Multiple Payment Options

Accept cash, UPI, card, or bank transfer and record all payments properly in bills. The
[multipayment feature][60] of our GST billing software ensures smooth transaction tracking by
automatically updating records for every sale.

[Discount & Tax Handling][Discount & Tax Handling]

### Discount & Tax Handling

Apply [item-level or overall discounts ][61]and multiple tax rates within a single bill. This
feature simplifies GST calculations and discounts, ensuring accurate invoices in your daily billing
process.

[E-invoice & E-way Bill Creation][E-invoice & E-way Bill Creation]

### E-invoice & E-way Bill Creation

Generate GST-compliant e-invoices and [create e-way bills][62] instantly from a billing platform
while ensuring faster, error-free invoicing and shipment tracking for your business.

[Automated Bill Numbering][Automated Bill Numbering]

### Automated Bill Numbering

Automatically organizes invoices with unique numbers and status updates, helping businesses maintain
proper records and simplify GST filing and audits.

[WhatsApp Billing & Reminders][WhatsApp Billing & Reminders]

### WhatsApp Billing & Reminders

Send invoices and [payment reminders on WhatsApp][63] directly to customers through our app. This
allows instant sharing of bills and reminders, and helps businesses collect payments faster.

[Barcode Generator & Scanner][Barcode Generator & Scanner]

### Barcode Generator & Scanner
