## Common questions

How do I book an apartment on Wunderflats?

You've found a suitable furnished apartment on Wunderflats? Great! Just send a non-binding booking
request by clicking "Request to book". We will get in touch with the landlord. They can either
accept or decline it, we will let you know as soon as we have an answer. As soon as they confirm the
apartment's availability and accept the request, you can book it. 



All you need to do is: 
* Complete your profile by verifying your identity and uploading all required documents 
* Confirm the booking 
* Pay the [Wunderflats Service Fee][7]
* Pay the [first month's rent][8] (only for certain listings)



That's it! At this point, the apartment is reserved for you. Now you and your landlord can sign a
rental agreement and organize your move-in.



Remember, your chances of a confirmed booking are significantly higher if you send multiple booking
requests for different apartments. If you have any questions, we are here to support you at every
step.



Click the photo to watch our video on YouTube on How to book an apartment:

[[Video: How to book an apartment]][9]







Or click the photo to check out our video on How to Find an Apartment.

[[Video: How to find an apartment]][10]

## Common questions

How do I book an apartment on Wunderflats?

You've found a suitable furnished apartment on Wunderflats? Great! Just send a non-binding booking
request by clicking "Request to book". We will get in touch with the landlord. They can either
accept or decline it, we will let you know as soon as we have an answer. As soon as they confirm the
apartment's availability and accept the request, you can book it. 



All you need to do is: 
* Complete your profile by verifying your identity and uploading all required documents 
* Confirm the booking 
* Pay the [Wunderflats Service Fee][7]
* Pay the [first month's rent][8] (only for certain listings)



That's it! At this point, the apartment is reserved for you. Now you and your landlord can sign a
rental agreement and organize your move-in.



Remember, your chances of a confirmed booking are significantly higher if you send multiple booking
requests for different apartments. If you have any questions, we are here to support you at every
step.



Click the photo to watch our video on YouTube on How to book an apartment:

[[Video: How to book an apartment]][9]







Or click the photo to check out our video on How to Find an Apartment.

[[Video: How to find an apartment]][10]



Can I book a Wunderflat over the phone?

On Wunderflats you can see all listings and send booking requests [online][11]. You can find the
availability of each apartment in the calendar section.

Unfortunately, you can't book an apartment over the phone, but if you need guidance, our Customer
Support Team will be happy to help.

Click the photo to watch our video on YouTube on How to book an apartment:

[[Video: How to book an apartment]][12]



Can I register my address if I book an apartment on Wunderflats (Anmeldung)?

Yes, as a tenant you can register your address at the registration office or citizens' office
(Anmeldung in Germany) in most apartments offered on Wunderflats.



Please look out for the information on the *confirmation of residence* (proof of address) in the
listing when you make your booking. If "landlord's confirmation of residence
(Wohnungsgeberbestätigung)" is included under "Services" as a feature of the apartment, then you can
register in this apartment with the authorities. 



To learn more, please click the photo to watch our video on YouTube:

[[Video: Anmeldung for German Tenants]][13]

Please find more information here on the [registration (Anmeldung)][14] and the [confirmation of
residence (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung)][15]. For more guidance on registration, have a look at our
article: [Anmeldung in Germany: how to register your address in Germany][16].





***Please note****:** This article does not constitute legal advice – the information on this page
has been prepared solely for your information. As we are not a law firm and act as a platform, we
can and may share our estimations, but we cannot give you legal advice for your individual further
proceedings*

Can I view the apartment before I rent it?

**Wunderflats is a fully digital platform, and most apartments are rented without a physical or
virtual viewing. This speeds up the booking process by several days and increases your chances of
securing the apartment you want.**

**We verify landlords and listings before they go live and offer strong tenant protection, so a
viewing is typically not necessary.**



Most listings include professional photos taken by certified real estate photographers. Look for the
watermark in the top right corner to spot them.



In rare cases, some landlords may offer a virtual or in-person tour. This depends on availability
and is often not possible when a property is still occupied. Many homes are rented just days before
the new tenant moves in, so viewings usually aren’t feasible.



We’re on a mission to make renting an equal experience. Removing the need for a viewing means anyone
can book a place, no matter where they are.



If an apartment differs significantly from the listing, we’ll support you in resolving the issue.



You’re always welcome to send multiple booking requests to explore your best options.



Click the photo to watch our video on YouTube - or click here to learn more about the [steps after
viewing an apartment.][17]

[[Video: Viewing an Apartment]][18]

[When is an apartment reserved for me?][19]

What happens after I send a booking request?

After you send a booking request, we will forward it to the landlord. They can either accept or
reject it, we will let you know as soon as we have an answer. In the meantime, you can send requests
for other Wunderflats free of charge to increase your chances of a successful booking: By requesting
at least 5 listings you’re 4 times more likely to get an apartment! 



Your booking request was accepted?

Great! To make sure you can successfully book the apartment, it's best to confirm it as soon as
possible. Please keep in mind that you can only confirm one booking at a time. In order to confirm
the booking, you'll need to complete your profile and upload the required documents to your account.
Once you confirm the booking request, the [Wunderflats Service Fee for tenants][20] and in some
cases also the [first month's rent][21] is due. The apartment is then [reserved for you][22]. At
this point, you can discuss the rental agreement and move-in details directly with the landlord.
* If you withdraw the accepted booking request, you can confirm another booking.
* If someone else was quicker to confirm than you, you will receive a "Reserved for another tenant"
  message.



Click the photo to watch our video on YouTube on How to book an apartment:

[[Video: How to Book an Apartment]][23]





Your booking request was rejected?

In [some cases][24], such as a change in availability, landlords can reject booking requests. You
can search available apartments, and send requests for the most suitable ones.

More information: 
* [How can I increase the chances of my booking request being accepted?][25]
* [Which documents should I have at hand?][26]

Which documents should I have at hand?

After submitting your first booking request, we'll let you know what documents are needed. To
expedite your booking, please upload all required documents to "My Documents" as soon as possible.



Click the photo to watch our video on YouTube:

[[Video: Tenant Verification & Documentation]][27]



We will need:
* Your current address
* A valid government-issued identity document for each person moving in. This is required for
  identity verification through the Wunderflats Account (find more information about [identity
  verification here][28]).

To verify your solvency, you can upload one of the following documents under "My account" -> ["My
documents"][29]: 
* Bank statement - Please ensure that the file meets the following requirements: 
  * Name on the document matches the main tenant’s name 
  * The document is not older than three months 
  * Net balance equals at least one month’s rent 
  * High quality photo or scan 
* Payslip - Please ensure that the file meets the following requirements: 
  * The name on the payslip matches the tenant’s name 
  * The document is not older than three months 
  * Net income is at least one month’s rent 
  * Good quality displaying the information clearly 
* If your company pays the rent for you: 
  *  A confirmation that they cover the monthly rent. You can use [this template][30] for the
    confirmation.
* If you are a student, intern or an apprentice: 
  * Financial evidence (e.g. a current bank account statement) or security by a third party
    including an income statement and a copy of the guarantor's ID or passport. You can use this
    [guarantee template][31].

We verify the identity and solvency of all tenants with these documents. You do not need to submit
any other documents, such as SCHUFA information.



Do I need SCHUFA information to rent an apartment with Wunderflats?

No, you do not need SCHUFA information to conclude a rental agreement through us. We use other
documents such as current payslips or bank account statements to check the financial liquidity of
all our tenants. 

Here you will find a list of the documents we require from you to prepare the rental
agreement: [Which documents should I have at hand?][32]

What costs are included in the rent?

At Wunderflats we work with all-inclusive rental prices, which also include the furniture surcharge
and monthly utilities such as heating, electricity, water, and internet

large overhang of excess supply in some markets have kept multifamily rent growth weak over the past
year. Yardi Matrix’s Summer 2026 outlook discusses these trends and the sector’s prospects in the
second half of the year.
